notes.title: Patch 1.05.1
notes.notes:
Just a small patch fixing some recently found bugs:

- Fixed bug in Tutorial where player could walk through brick wall.
- Fixed bug in Tutorial where cup would not delete when placed in garbage bin (thank you to Siles for reporting the bug!)
- Fixed bug in Disorientation where player could walk through certain trees (thank you to Siles for reporting the bug!)
